name: arc
description: A.R.C. code review from your coding agent. Start with arc-setup: it installs the arc CLI and configures it in your repository. Then review, fix, rot, automate and maintain drive the arc CLI; plus the review methods behind it — taste, smell, error and breaker checks, type naming, comment hygiene, the coding convention and shift-left guides for 9 languages — reading the same rubrics arc's reviewer reads.
